summary: Validated live API core flow and mobile Expo web flow: auth, bilingual toggle, navigation, booking with manual address, dispatch persistence, Orders, and invoice.

integration_issues.issue: Orders cards show a dispatch status label and invoice action, but no tracking entry/timeline action despite the requested tracking flow; backend status_history is not rendered.

action_items: Add an Orders tracking entry and render status_history/current status for active orders.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/backendUrl rather than the specified EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current preview works because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is configured, but deployment configuration should be aligned.
JWT_SECRET has a development fallback and backend logs show an insecure key-length warning; production must provide a 32+ byte JWT_SECRET.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ prefixed temporary customer, vehicle, and order through the public API; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview https://moontir-client.preview.emergentagent.com. Supplied customer login and mobile viewport 375x667 passed. Booking used manual address; geocode/location-denial and sign-out were not exercised in this run.
rca_of_issue: Order tracking UI omission is visible in OrderCard: it renders a hard-coded Dispatch active label and invoice button, but never maps order.status_history or provides a tracking navigation/modal. Backend already returns status and status_history.
